subject.title: fix(ui): add timeout to control-ui bootstrap config fetch

question: Should the Control UI treat 15 seconds as the fixed compatibility boundary after which valid server bootstrap metadata is silently replaced by defaults?
rationale: Source and standalone browser evidence support adding a deadline, but repository policy makes the exact startup fallback threshold an owner decision because it changes behavior for slow existing deployments.

options.title: Accept 15 seconds with app proof
options.body: Keep the focused patch after the contributor demonstrates the actual built Control UI falling back successfully and preserving a near-deadline successful response.

options.title: Choose another timeout policy
options.body: Ask the Control UI owner to select a different shared deadline or fallback behavior and update the tests and browser proof accordingly.

options.title: Pause the timeout change
options.body: Leave current behavior unchanged if maintainers cannot justify a universal cutoff for supported reverse-proxy deployments.

recommendation.title: Accept 15 seconds with app proof
recommendation.body: Keep the focused patch after the contributor demonstrates the actual built Control UI falling back successfully and preserving a near-deadline successful response.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeout changes the authenticated bootstrap-config fallback boundary previously associated with this adjacent ownership history.
